description: This file defines an Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) advice class in Java for the OpenMRS healthcare platform. The class, RequiredDataAdvice, intercepts save, void, unvoid, retire, and unretire service method calls, automatically populating metadata fields such as creator, dateChanged, dateVoided, etc., on OpenMRS domain objects before the actual database operation. It handles complex recursive processing of object graphs, supports annotated configuration for direct field access, disables handling for certain fields, and manages external handler plugins. Its purpose is to automate the setting of common required metadata in a standardized manner across the OpenMRS core.

classes.name: RequiredDataAdvice
classes.description: AOP advice class that intercepts service layer method calls to automatically set or update metadata fields such as creator, date changed, voided by, etc., on OpenMRS domain objects. It handles recursive processing of nested objects and collections, via reflection and handler plugins, to ensure consistent metadata population across the system.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Intercepts service method calls before execution, determines the method type (save, void, retire, etc.), and populates associated metadata on the first argument or collection of arguments, handling nested object graphs recursively.

methods.name: methodNameEndsWithClassName
methods.description: Checks whether a method name ends with the class name of the object being processed, considering class inheritance, used to determine if the method applies to the object type.

methods.name: recursivelyHandle
methods.description: Overloaded static methods that process an object and its nested object graph, applying a specific handler type (save, void, retire, etc.) to each. It manages already handled objects to prevent infinite recursion.

methods.name: getChildCollection
methods.description: Uses reflection to access a child collection property of an OpenMRS object, either via getter method or directly, considering annotations that allow or restrict direct access.

methods.name: isOpenmrsObjectCollection
methods.description: Determines whether an object is a non-empty collection of OpenMRS domain objects.

methods.name: isHandlerMarkedAsDisabled
methods.description: Checks whether a particular handler type is disabled for a specific field, based on the presence of the DisableHandlers annotation.
